accepted.s: The provisions relating to Articles 31A and 31B and the Ninth Schedule were introduced into the Constitution by which Constitutional Amendment?
accepted.x: The First Amendment Act, 1951 introduced Articles 31A and 31B and added the Ninth Schedule. It also amended the grounds of restriction under Article 19(2) and inserted Article 15(4).
accepted.tq: Use the amendment-to-subject association rather than relying on the sequence of amendment numbers.

accepted.s: Which one of the following was a major feature of the Seventh Constitutional Amendment Act, 1956?
o: Creation of the National Capital Territory of Delhi
Reorganisation of States and abolition of the former Part A, Part B, Part C and Part D classification
accepted.x: The Seventh Amendment, 1956 accompanied the reorganisation of States, abolished the Part A, B, C and D classification, repealed Part VII and dealt with Union Territories.
accepted.tq: Match the amendment with its distinctive structural change and reject provisions belonging to later amendments.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Twenty-fourth Constitutional Amendment Act, 1971:
1. It inserted Article 13(4).
2. It made the President's assent to a Constitution Amendment Bill obligatory.
3. It empowered Parliament to amend Fundamental Rights.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Twenty-fourth Amendment inserted Article 13(4), amended Article 368 and clarified Parliament's power to amend Fundamental Rights. It also made presidential assent obligatory for a Constitution Amendment Bill.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against the amendment's linked changes to Articles 13 and 368.

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

Amendment — Principal subject
1. 44th — Property as a legal right
2. 52nd — Tenth Schedule
3. 69th — Articles 239AA and 239AB
4. 86th — Article 21A

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct. The 44th Amendment removed the right to property from Part III while retaining it as a legal right; the 52nd introduced the Tenth Schedule; the 69th provided Delhi's special constitutional framework; and the 86th inserted Article 21A.
accepted.tq: Verify each amendment-subject pair independently before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Constitutional Amendments in chronological order:
A. Twenty-fourth Amendment
B. Forty-second Amendment
C. Fifty-second Amendment
D. Sixty-first Amendment
accepted.x: The Twenty-fourth Amendment was enacted in 1971, the Forty-second in 1976, the Fifty-second in 1985 and the Sixty-first in 1988.
accepted.tq: Anchor the sequence with the amendment years before comparing the middle items.

accepted.s: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment inserted Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule, whereas the 74th Constitutional Amendment inserted
o: Part IXA and the Twelfth Schedule
Part XIVA and the Twelfth Schedule
Part IVA and the Eleventh Schedule
Part IX and the Eighth Schedule
accepted.x: The 73rd Amendment dealt with Panchayats through Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule. The 74th Amendment dealt with Municipalities through Part IXA and the Twelfth Schedule.
accepted.tq: Separate the rural and urban local-government amendments by their Parts and Schedules.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act?
o: Eighteen matters in the Twelfth Schedule and Part IXA
Ten Fundamental Duties in Part IVA
Twenty-nine matters in the Eleventh Schedule
Free and compulsory education under Article 21A
accepted.x: The 74th Amendment provided for Municipalities, inserted Part IXA and added the Twelfth Schedule containing 18 functional matters.
accepted.tq: Use the rural–urban distinction to detect the swapped Schedule and Part.

accepted.s:
With reference to the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, consider the following statements:
1. It inserted Article 21A.
2. It modified Article 45.
3. It added a Fundamental Duty under Article 51A(k).
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The 86th Amendment inserted Article 21A concerning education for children aged 6–14 years, modified Article 45 and added Article 51A(k) as a Fundamental Duty.
accepted.tq: Treat the three constitutional locations—Article 21A, Article 45 and Article 51A(k)—as a single amendment cluster.

accepted.s: Which of the following amendments was enacted in 1988 but came into force in 1989?
accepted.x: The Sixty-first Amendment was enacted in 1988 and came into force in 1989. It reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the year of enactment from the year of commencement when both are supplied.

accepted.s: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act was introduced in the Lok Sabha in:
accepted.x: The Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Bill was introduced in the Lok Sabha in September 1976 during the Emergency period.
accepted.tq: Read the question as a precise date-recall item rather than confusing introduction with enactment.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s: The Forty-second Constitutional Amendment is called the 'Mini-Constitution' primarily because it
o: was applicable only during the period of Emergency
made sweeping changes in the Preamble, the Seventh Schedule and about 54 Articles
created a miniature version of the Constitution for Union Territories
was enacted through a short constitutional procedure without parliamentary debate
accepted.x: The 42nd Amendment made wide-ranging changes to the Preamble, the Seventh Schedule and about 54 Articles. Its sweeping scope led to the description 'Mini-Constitution'.
accepted.tq: Identify the reason behind a constitutional nickname instead of treating it as a formal title.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s:
Which of the following words were added to the Preamble by the Forty-second Constitutional Amendment?
1. Socialist
2. Secular
3. Integrity
4. Justice

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Forty-second Amendment added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular' and 'Integrity' to the Preamble. 'Justice' was already present in the original Preamble.
accepted.tq: Separate words added by amendment from words already present in the original Preamble.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s: Which one of the following was NOT a Directive Principle inserted by the Forty-second Constitutional Amendment?
o: Protection and improvement of the environment
Equal justice and free legal aid
Uniform civil code for the citizens
Participation of workers in management of industries
accepted.x: Articles 39A, 43A and 48A were added by the 42nd Amendment. The Directive Principle relating to a Uniform Civil Code is Article 44 and was not inserted by that amendment.
accepted.tq: Find the established constitutional provision that does not belong to the amendment-specific group.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s:
Which of the following subjects was transferred from the State List to the Concurrent List by the Forty-second Amendment?
1. Education
2. Forests
3. Weights and measures
4. Administration of justice

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The 42nd Amendment transferred education, forests, weights and measures, protection of wild animals and birds, and administration of justice from the State List to the Concurrent List.
accepted.tq: Test the complete list and watch for omission of one transferred subject.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s: Which one of the following was a change made by the Forty-second Constitutional Amendment?
o: Extension of the term of the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies from five to six years
Abolition of tribunals under Part XIVA
Reduction of the term of the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies to four years
Removal of Article 368 from the Constitution
accepted.x: The 42nd Amendment extended the term of the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies from five to six years. It also inserted Part XIVA relating to tribunals and froze delimitation on the basis of the 1971 Census.
accepted.tq: Use the reversed-term trap: the 42nd extended, rather than reduced, legislative terms.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Forty-second Amendment:
1. It inserted Part IVA dealing with Fundamental Duties.
2. It inserted Part XIVA dealing with tribunals.
3. It permitted proclamation of Emergency in only the entire territory of India and not a part of it.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The 42nd Amendment enabled an Emergency to be proclaimed in a part of India; therefore, statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Spot the absolute territorial limitation introduced through the word 'only'.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly identifies a provision later struck down by the Supreme Court in Minerva Mills case?
o: The Tenth Schedule inserted by the 52nd Amendment
Articles 368(4) and 368(5) inserted by the 42nd Amendment
accepted.x: The Minerva Mills judgment of 1980 struck down Articles 368(4) and 368(5), which had been inserted by the 42nd Amendment, and also invalidated the wider version of Article 31C.
accepted.tq: Link the judicial decision to the exact constitutional provisions challenged, not merely to the amendment number.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s: Which Constitutional Amendment restored the five-year term of the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies after the Forty-second Amendment had extended it to six years?
accepted.x: The Forty-fourth Amendment, 1978 restored the normal five-year term of the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies and restored judicial review in important respects.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the two post-Emergency amendments by the specific excess each addressed.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s: The Forty-third Constitutional Amendment Act, 1977 repealed which set of provisions associated with the Forty-second Amendment?
accepted.x: The 43rd Amendment repealed Articles 32A, 131A, 144A, 226A and 228A, which had restricted the jurisdiction and powers of constitutional courts.
accepted.tq: Use the exact article cluster to identify the provisions repealed by the 43rd Amendment.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. 96th Amendment — Oriya renamed Odia
2. 97th Amendment — Cooperative societies
3. 101st Amendment — Goods and Services Tax
4. 102nd Amendment — Constitutional status to the NCBC

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct. The 96th, 97th, 101st and 102nd Amendments respectively dealt with the name Odia, cooperative societies, GST and constitutional status for the NCBC under Article 338B.
accepted.tq: Build a recent-amendment timeline and verify each amendment against its distinctive subject.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. 103rd Amendment — 10 per cent EWS reservation
2. 105th Amendment — Restoration of States' power to identify their own SEBCs
3. 106th Amendment — Women's reservation
4. 91st Amendment — Introduction of anti-defection provisions for the first time
Which of the pairs given above is/are correct?
accepted.x: The 103rd, 105th and 106th Amendments correspond to EWS reservation, restoration of States' SEBC-identification power and women's reservation respectively. Anti-defection was introduced by the 52nd Amendment; the 91st later modified it.
accepted.tq: Use the amendment chronology to catch the swapped original anti-defection amendment.

accepted.s: The Twelfth Constitutional Amendment Act, 1962 is associated with which of the following?
o: Creating Delhi as a National Capital Territory
Making Goa, Daman and Diu a Union Territory
accepted.x: The Twelfth Amendment of 1962 made Goa, Daman and Diu a Union Territory. Sikkim's constitutional integration and Delhi's NCT status were dealt with by different amendments.
accepted.tq: Use the territorial-change association and eliminate provisions belonging to later amendments.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements correctly describes the growth of Parts of the Constitution referred to in the amendment framework?
1. Part IVA was added by the Forty-second Amendment.
2. Part IXA was added by the Seventy-fourth Amendment.
3. Part IXB was added by the Ninety-seventh Amendment.
4. Part VII was repealed by the Seventh Amendment.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. These changes explain the increase in the number of Parts from 22 to 25: Parts IVA, IXA and IXB were added, while Part VII was repealed.
accepted.tq: Track additions and repeal together instead of counting only newly inserted Parts.

accepted.s:
Which one of the following is correctly matched with its year of commencement?
1. Seventy-third Amendment — 24 April 1993
2. Seventy-fourth Amendment — 1 June 1993
3. Sixty-first Amendment — 1989

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The 73rd Amendment came into force on 24 April 1993, the 74th on 1 June 1993, and the 61st Amendment came into force in 1989 after being enacted in 1988.
accepted.tq: Separate enactment years from commencement dates and test each date independently.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the 42nd Constitutional Amendment is INCORRECT?
o: It was enacted during the Emergency when Indira Gandhi was Prime Minister.
It added 'Socialist', 'Secular' and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.
It inserted Part IVA and Article 51A.
It completely repealed the Fundamental Duties through the Forty-third Amendment.
accepted.x: The 42nd Amendment introduced Fundamental Duties through Part IVA and Article 51A; they were not repealed by the 43rd Amendment. The Preamble additions and the Emergency context are correct.
accepted.tq: Find the false reversal of a later corrective amendment and the original 42nd-Amendment change.
accepted.sec: 42nd Amendment - changes made, Mini-Constitution tag, what was undone later
